name: Backup a Registry Key
description: Export a Windows Registry key to a .reg file on a schedule — a lightweight way to snapshot configuration before it drifts or before a risky change.

parameters.label: Registry key path
parameters.help: Full registry path to export, e.g. HKLM\SOFTWARE\MyApp.

parameters.label: Output .reg path
parameters.help: Where to write the exported key. /y overwrites an existing file.
